purpose: Prospective role assignment for monetary-transmission validation recovery after official-source coverage inspection and before any Alpha 0.5.x model estimation or selection.

policy_rate.source: BIS central bank policy rates, M.RO

household_target.definition: RON new-business lending for house purchase, households/NPISH, AAR/NDER, total initial fixation

nfc_target.definition: RON new-business loans to NFCs, variable rate / initial rate fixation up to one year, AAR/NDER, total amount category
nfc_target.reason_selected_over_total_series: The total-maturity NFC series contains numerous official missing observations; no imputation is permitted.

calibration.scientific_reason: Includes the 2018 tightening episode, 2020 easing and the 2021-2022 tightening cycle; used only to estimate parsimonious parameters.

structural_selection.scientific_reason: Includes the extended 7 percent plateau and July-August 2024 easing. Previously inspected Nov-2024..Jan-2025 observations are allowed here because this window is not claimed as independent validation.

final_evaluation_holdout.scientific_reason: Fresh independent evaluation window relative to prior Alpha 0.5 work. It is reserved before estimation/selection and will be opened once only after model form and structural-selection verdict are frozen.
final_evaluation_holdout.limitation: The policy rate is expected to be much less variable than in earlier cycles, so passing this holdout alone cannot validate pass-through dynamics.

coverage_inspected_not_independent.reason: Tail values were inspected during source-coverage verification before this split was frozen; they are permanently ineligible as independent evaluation for Alpha 0.5.x.

future_confirmation_holdout.rule: Future MIR observations from 2026-08 onward are reserved for later confirmation and may not be used to revise the Alpha 0.5.x selected structure before their first formal evaluation.

model_selection_rule: Only calibration and structural-selection windows may influence model form, lag choice among predeclared parsimonious candidates, or parameter estimation procedure. Final evaluation cannot rescue a structure that fails structural selection.
old_holdout_rule: Nov-2024..Jan-2025 from Alpha 0.5 has already been inspected and is explicitly reclassified as structural-selection information, never independent validation.
missing_data_rule: No interpolation, carry-forward, synthetic allocation or zero-fill is permitted for missing lending-rate observations.
